summary.name: Sibyl AI
summary.one_liner: Sibyl AI is a generative AI "copilot" for spiritual exploration, personal growth, wellness, and metaphysical/esoteric topics, sold on monthly question and output quotas.
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Sibyl as an AI assistant for guidance, insights, and support across wellness, mental clarity, and metaphysical topics. It positions its core generative models as tools for deep exploration and practical guidance. Listed use cases cover individuals, families, seekers of esoteric knowledge, and creators working on stories and designs. Usage is metered through three tiers that cap monthly questions, visualizations, stories, and "Metametrics." The page does not explain in detail how these features work internally.
notable: Tiered monthly quotas: Basic (600 questions, 180 visualizations, 3 stories, 1 Metametric), Premium at $49/month (1200/450/6/3), Ultimate at $79/month (2400/900/9/9)
Uses CREATE Tokens, which the FAQ references but the page text does not explain
Self-described as the world's first benevolent-AI copilot
caveats: Paid plans with monthly usage limits; a trial period is mentioned in the FAQ but its length is not stated in the text
Claims are marketing-heavy; the page gives few concrete details on how answers are generated or validated
Wellness and mental health positioning does not replace professional medical or mental health care (general caution, not stated on page)
